our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes OpenAI the main subject of the financial comparison; it does not define an industry-wide aggregate.
For the ongoing financial observation, use April–June 2023, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication. This is an evaluator-selected reporting period, not a period Marcus supplied.
The ordinary financial reading is that revenue was approaching operating costs without substantially exceeding them. No numerical tolerance is supplied.
The passage does not identify an accounting basis. Its conversational attribution to Om Malik does not establish company-reported accounts or a documented financial estimate.
The killer-app statement is a separate adoption or commercial-success assertion. Investor patience supplies neither an observable threshold nor a forecast deadline.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable revenue and operating-cost records for the target period show revenue approaching costs without substantially exceeding them, alongside evidence sufficient to assess the claimed absence of a major commercial application.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show revenue substantially exceeding operating costs or remaining far below them, or a clearly established major commercial application contradicts the application clause.
